source-integrity.name: provenance
source-integrity.basis: SEC filing identity, issuer operating evidence and independent current valuation are source-addressed and origin-separated.

source-integrity.name: freshness
source-integrity.basis: Operating evidence is from the quarter ended June 30, 2026 and valuation is dated September 24, 2026.

source-integrity.name: sourceIndependence
source-integrity.basis: Operating facts remain issuer/SEC-derived; current valuation adds an independent market-data origin, while duplicated Q2 issuer lineage is explicitly collapsed.

company-underwriting.name: underwriting
company-underwriting.basis: Strong strategic positioning and improving operating conversion are balanced by demanding valuation and execution/policy dependence.

structural-causal.name: bottleneckControl
structural-causal.basis: Domestic mine-to-separated-product-to-magnet capability addresses multiple stages of a concentrated rare-earth supply chain.

structural-causal.name: supplyChainResilience
structural-causal.basis: Domestic downstream conversion can diversify strategic magnet supply if ramp and qualification succeed.

structural-causal.name: scenarioRobustness
structural-causal.basis: Strategic demand is broad, while economics remain sensitive to ramp execution, policy support and rare-earth pricing.

structural-causal.name: substitutionResilience
structural-causal.basis: NdFeB magnets are performance-critical in many applications, but motor redesign, recycling and alternative magnet chemistries can reduce intensity in some uses.

discovery-weak-signals.name: domestic rare-earth vertical integration
discovery-weak-signals.basis: Rising separated-product output, magnetics revenue and new defense/offtake programs broaden evidence of downstream conversion.

adversarial-red-team.name: policyDependence
adversarial-red-team.basis: Government support can de-risk strategic capacity while obscuring unsupported market economics.

adversarial-red-team.name: executionConcentration
adversarial-red-team.basis: Multiple large ramp programs create correlated schedule and qualification exposure.

adversarial-red-team.name: confidenceInflation
adversarial-red-team.basis: Commercial milestones are real, but future 10X utilization and economics are not yet achieved facts.

expectations-execution.name: execution conversion
expectations-execution.basis: Commercial magnetics revenue/EBITDA and record-scale NdPr sales show tangible conversion while major capacity programs remain forward execution tests.

thesisQuality.basis: Commercial separated-product growth plus commenced magnet manufacturing demonstrate real adoption and differentiated domestic integration; unsupported long-run economics cap the score below exceptional.

financialOperatingMomentum.basis: Revenue accelerated materially and liquidity exceeds stated debt, but price-protection income and heavy expansion requirements make quality mixed rather than exceptional.

marketValuationOpportunity.basis: Approximately $8.78B market cap versus roughly $416M TTM revenue and negative net income embeds demanding downstream expectations despite strategic optionality.

catalystScore.basis: 10X, Independence, DoW-linked expansion and GM/Apple supply arrangements create several identifiable operating catalysts, though commissioning and qualification remain future execution tests.

governancePower.basis: Current proxy disclosure and SEC reporting support functional governance/transparency, while the evidence set does not justify exceptional long-duration capital-allocation claims.

alignment2036.basis: Rare-earth separation and NdFeB magnets are critical inputs across EVs, robotics, drones, wind and defense, giving foundational exposure across multiple plausible 2036 futures.

crossDivisionLeverage.basis: Materials and Magnetics reuse the same rare-earth chain across automotive, defense, robotics and industrial demand, but economics still depend heavily on one strategic materials complex.

bottleneckControl.basis: Mountain Pass is described as the only rare-earth mining and processing site of scale in North America and MP has added domestic magnet manufacturing, creating unusually scarce integrated capability.

scenarioRobustness.basis: End-market breadth supports several demand scenarios, but rare-earth pricing, trade policy, government support and ramp execution remain material common-mode exposures.

substitutionResilience.basis: High-performance NdFeB demand and qualification barriers support resilience, while recycling, motor redesign and alternative magnet chemistries remain credible substitution paths.

supplyChainResilience.basis: Domestic mine-to-separation-to-magnet integration reduces foreign conversion dependence, but expansion commissioning and customer qualification remain concentrated execution dependencies.

pricingPower.basis: The price-protection agreement materially stabilizes rare-earth pricing and strategic supply agreements improve revenue visibility, but this is partly contractual/policy support rather than fully demonstrated standalone scarcity rent.

riskEvidence.basis: Moderate-high execution and policy dependence: simultaneous capacity ramps, qualification risk, trade-policy exposure and economics partly supported by price protection offset strong liquidity and strategic contracts.

dataConfidenceEvidence.basis: Recent SEC financials, proxy disclosure and current independent valuation cover the required dimensions, but future utilization/unit economics and independent corroboration of operating claims remain incomplete.

scoreRecord.thesis: MP is converting a scarce North American rare-earth resource into an integrated separation-and-magnet platform with strategic multi-market relevance; upside depends on successful downstream ramp and durable economics beyond policy support.
scoreRecord.keyRisk: Valuation and expansion economics can disappoint if 10X/Independence utilization, qualification or unsupported market economics fall short, especially if policy/price protection weakens.
scoreRecord.nextCatalyst: Further commercial magnet shipments and evidence of 10X/Independence commissioning, qualification and utilization progression.
